parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activities for compounds tested against human BTK (CHEMBL5251) that have a canonical SMILES string and a PubMed ID or DOI. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Use the join path molecule_dictionary -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary, with an INNER JOIN to compound_structures to enforce the presence of canonical_smiles. Join docs via activities.doc_id to retrieve pubmed_id_or_doi. Join compound_records via activities.record_id to retrieve compound_key. Filter by target CHEMBL5251, standard_type = 'IC50', and require canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL and (pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR doi IS NOT NULL). Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
